f.m.progress: every 9 weeks with the report card
f.red[0].beh: Head-directed self-injury: striking the head or face with a closed fist or open hand, or hitting the head against a surface, with audible contact. Not: rubbing the eyes, resting the head on the desk.
f.red[0].cur: 2.4 per minute (EA-1 alone condition; 110 per school day on DD-1)
f.red[0].ctx: Separate day school, classroom of 6 with 1:1 staff; nurse on site
f.red[0].meth: a frequency count in every session, recorded on DD-1 by the classroom staff
f.acq[1].beh: engage with the leisure items chosen to give a similar sensation (instead of the problem behavior)
f.acq[1].cond: during free time with the matched leisure items within reach
f.acq[1].meth: partial-interval (problem behavior) and momentary time sampling (engagement) on Form MT-1
f.acq[1].note: From the objective bank: Use leisure items that give similar sensation (Piazza et al., 2000; Shore et al., 1997).
